journal_lines: §aKicked a stone that rang instead of thudded. §oHollow. Cracked it open. Violet inside.
§aSomething underfoot that rang wrong. §oGeode, small, round. Broke it open with a rock. Worth it.
§aThe stone in the streambed had been worked on by the water for years. §oI finished in a few minutes. Crystals inside.
§aTripped on a rounded stone that rolled and rang. §oSet it down. Listened. Opened it. Good.
§aNo pickaxe. Did not need one. §oPatience and the right angle. The crystals inside were waiting.
§aFound a geode at the cave wall's edge, half-buried. §oCracked it with the back of an axe. Purple inside, tight and bright.
§aCrystals like small frozen flames. §oCarried them home wrapped in my kit. Didn't want them to touch anything harder.
§aHollow rock. §oThe sound was the tell. Broke it open carefully. Took everything inside that was loose.
